claim_boundary: This matrix defines design and verification interfaces only. It does not evidence land rights, funding, appointed bodies, compute agreements, permits, procurement, confirmed cooperation or field performance. Unknown evidence cannot be promoted by AI.
path_rule: taskbook -> element -> spatial interface -> mechanism -> conceptual role -> evidence -> phase gate -> stop/hold/downgrade

elements.mechanism_zh: 在暂定重点区和概念用地层中预留公共界面、临时使用触发条件与地块接口核验位，不提出权属或调规结论。
elements.mechanism_en: Reserve public interfaces, temporary-use triggers and parcel-interface verification points in provisional key areas and concept land-use layers without asserting title or rezoning.
elements.stage_gate: An authorised owner/interface record, lawful public access and applicable planning or heritage constraints are available.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: HOLD the spatial activation and retain only a provisional diagram when ownership, access, permission or control conditions are absent or conflict.
elements.ai_off_relationship: Land and access decisions remain human and documentary; AI has no promotion authority.

elements.mechanism_zh: 以公共清晰带、支持点、停留预留和人工兜底组成可撤回空间底盘，再叠加可选数字和 AI 服务。
elements.mechanism_en: Use clearways, support points, stay reservations and human fallback as a removable spatial base before optional digital and AI services.
elements.stage_gate: Legal public passage, accessibility, maintenance and AI-OFF legibility are recorded for the selected interface.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: STOP or reroute when a clearway, crossing or accessible alternative fails; DOWNGRADE when maintenance or fallback is unavailable.
elements.ai_off_relationship: Physical direction and human help remain usable without phone, screen or AI.

elements.mechanism_zh: 把众智园研究测试、AI 原点公众解释、大钟寺日常反馈连接为问题登记、受限验证、公开复盘和长期转化漏斗。
elements.mechanism_en: Connect Zhongzhiyuan research tests, AI Origin public explanation and Dazhongsi daily feedback as a funnel from problem registration to bounded validation, public review and long-term conversion.
elements.stage_gate: A named operator, lawful test window, public bypass, safety/privacy review and conversion evidence are available.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: STOP the test interface if safety, privacy or permission fails; HOLD conversion without an appointed body, resources and operating commitment.
elements.ai_off_relationship: The research or industry layer may switch off while public passage, fixed information and human appeal remain.

elements.mechanism_zh: 以阶段门和工作包定义未来公共利益采购、试点资源确认及运维承诺的触发顺序，不给出预算或资金来源。
elements.mechanism_en: Use phase gates and work packages to define the future trigger order for public-interest procurement, pilot resources and maintenance commitment without naming a budget or funding source.
elements.stage_gate: A lawful procurement or funding record covers the bounded work package, lifecycle maintenance and failure response.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: HOLD procurement and activation when funding, lifecycle responsibility or permitted use is undocumented; remove unfunded service claims.
elements.ai_off_relationship: No financial decision is delegated to AI; non-digital public-service obligations remain explicit.

elements.mechanism_zh: 通过公开讲座、导师时段、现场核验训练、开发者最小测试协议和公众反馈形成可退出的人才交流接口。
elements.mechanism_en: Use public talks, mentor windows, field-verification training, developer minimum-test protocols and public feedback as an exit-capable talent exchange interface.
elements.stage_gate: A named host, public programme, accessibility plan, rights record and human safeguarding process are confirmed.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: HOLD the programme when no host, access plan or rights record exists; STOP any activity that bypasses consent, privacy or public passage.
elements.ai_off_relationship: Human teaching, fixed material and public discussion remain available without AI mediation.

elements.mechanism_zh: 只定义可选边缘/云服务接口、最低可用性记录和失效降级要求，不声称已签约或已获得任何算力。
elements.mechanism_en: Define only optional edge/cloud interfaces, minimum availability records and failure-degradation requirements without claiming contracted or allocated compute.
elements.stage_gate: A named service owner documents availability, security, energy/interface requirements, monitoring and an AI-OFF exercise.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: Disable the AI layer when compute, security, auditability or responsible operation fails; retain physical and human service only.
elements.ai_off_relationship: Compute failure is an expected degradation state and cannot remove physical direction or human fallback.

elements.mechanism_zh: 以来源、时间、位置、核验者、有效期和隐私边界组成证据账本；个人身份、人脸和未清权运营数据不进入。
elements.mechanism_en: Use provenance, time, location, verifier, validity and privacy boundaries as the evidence ledger; exclude personal identity, faces and uncleared operational data.
elements.stage_gate: Each claim has lawful, current, task-specific evidence recorded by an authorised human and independently auditable.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: Retain unknown or DOWNGRADE when evidence is missing or stale; STOP and reject evidence written by AI or containing prohibited personal data.
elements.ai_off_relationship: The ledger and physical warning remain readable offline; AI cannot write observed, verified or rejected states.

elements.mechanism_zh: 将 SC-01—10 和 IV-01—03 绑定到节点、公共绕行、人工兜底、许可窗口、证据门和停止响应。
elements.mechanism_en: Bind SC-01–10 and IV-01–03 to nodes, public bypass, human fallback, permitted windows, evidence gates and stop responses.
elements.stage_gate: The scenario has a lawful site window, public bypass, human fallback, evidence protocol, privacy review and named stop authority.
elements.stop_hold_downgrade: STOP testing when passage, safety or privacy fails; HOLD when permission or evidence is missing; DOWNGRADE to fixed physical information when AI or operations fail.
elements.ai_off_relationship: Every scenario retains a declared human and physical response and may refuse or disable AI without loss of public access.
